question: Who among the following founded the Aligarh Muslim University in 1875?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Syed Ahmed Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Syed Ahmed Khan founded the Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College in 1875, which later became the Aligarh Muslim University in 1920.
 
• He was a prominent educator, Islamic reformer, and politician during the British Raj in India.
 
• His aim was to promote modern education among Muslims in India and to bridge the gap between the British and Indian Muslims.
 
• Syed Ahmed Khan is often credited with laying the foundation for the modern education system for Muslims in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aligarh Movement**

 
 
• The Aligarh Movement, started by Syed Ahmed Khan, aimed at reforming the social, educational, and political aspects of Muslim society in India.
 
• It emphasized the importance of modern education and scientific knowledge.
 
• The movement led to the establishment of several educational institutions and the promotion of Western-style education among Indian Muslims.
 
 
 
• **Syed Ahmed Khan's Contributions**
 
 
• He was a strong advocate for the adoption of Western education among Muslims.
 
• He founded several schools and colleges, including the Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College.
 
• He wrote extensively on various subjects, including education, religion, and social issues.
 
• He was knighted by the British government in 1888 for his services to education and social reform.
 
 
 
• **Aligarh Muslim University**
 
 
• Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) is one of the oldest and most prestigious educational institutions in India.
 
• It offers a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in various fields of study.
 
• AMU has played a significant role in the development of modern education and research in India.
 
• The university has a diverse student body and is known for its inclusive and secular environment.
